evals.prompt: SIMULATION ONLY: do not inspect a repository, call a ticket provider, or mutate files. The current branch is feature/PROJ-123-discount, a settled prep-ticket report and written plan are available, and the repository has no contract files. Describe the exact /exec-ticket PROJ-123 action trace.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the ticket and branch, loads repository instructions plus the settled prep-ticket evidence and plan, records one lazy reuse decision per implementation responsibility, and implements every observable behavior through RED, GREEN, and REFACTOR. It continues without approval artifacts, runs focused and full suites, and reports each behavior with its pinning test, changed files, and suite results.
expectations: continues from the settled plan without requiring approval artifacts
loads repository instructions and prep-ticket evidence
records one reuse decision per implementation responsibility before RED
implements one observable behavior at a time through RED, GREEN, and REFACTOR
runs focused and full test suites
maps every implemented behavior to its pinning test in the report

evals.prompt: SIMULATION ONLY: do not inspect a repository, call a ticket provider, or mutate files. /exec-ticket PROJ-123 is invoked on feature/PROJ-123-discount; the ticket provider is unavailable, but branch, diff, repository instructions, prep-ticket evidence, and a settled plan sufficiently identify the requested behavior. Describe the exact action trace.
evals.expected_output: Records the ticket-provider lookup gap, proceeds from sufficient branch, diff, repository, prep-ticket, and plan evidence without entering a question loop, continues without approval artifacts, then runs the same reuse-first RED/GREEN/REFACTOR implementation and focused/full verification. The final report states the provider gap alongside behavior-to-test, changed-file, and suite evidence.
expectations: records the unavailable ticket provider as a report gap
continues from sufficient repository, diff, prep-ticket, and plan evidence
does not start a question loop when local evidence is sufficient
reports the provider gap and verification evidence

evals.prompt: SIMULATION ONLY: do not inspect a repository, call a ticket provider, or mutate files. The settled plan says percentages above 100 must be rejected, but an implementation discovery says the requested user-visible outcome should instead clamp them to 100. Describe the exact /exec-ticket action trace.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the discovery as a material change to the requested user-visible outcome, stops before writing tests or source that encode the changed outcome, reports the original behavior, discovery, and decision required, and returns to the normal design process. It does not quietly encode the new outcome or continue verification as if the plan were unchanged.
expectations: recognizes a material user-visible outcome change
stops before writing tests or source for the changed outcome
reports the discovery and the decision required
returns to the normal design process
does not quietly implement the changed outcome
